gold_sql:
WITH origin AS (
  SELECT ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-111.516134 36.880453)',4326) AS pt
),
nearby_tiles AS (
  SELECT d.rast
  FROM public.dem_us d, origin o
  WHERE d.rast && ST_Expand(o.pt, 1.0)
),
masked AS (
	  SELECT ST_MapAlgebra(
	           rast,
	           1,
	           '32BF'::text,
	           'CASE WHEN [rast.val] > 1400 THEN [rast.val] ELSE NULL END'::text,
	           NULL::double precision
	         ) AS rast
  FROM nearby_tiles
),
qualifying_pixels AS (
  SELECT (pp).geom AS geom
  FROM masked
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL ST_PixelAsCentroids(rast, 1, TRUE) AS pp
)
SELECT MIN(ST_Distance(p.geom::geography, o.pt::geography)) AS distance_m
FROM qualifying_pixels p, origin o;

WITH horseshoe_bend AS (
  SELECT 
    ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(-111.516134, 36.880453), 4326)::geography AS geom
),
elevated_cells AS (
  SELECT 
    (ST_DumpAsPolygons(r.rast, 1)).geom AS geom
  FROM 
    public.dem_us r
  WHERE 
    ST_Value(r.rast, 1) > 1400
    AND ST_Intersects(r.rast, (SELECT geom FROM horseshoe_bend))
),
nearest_cell AS (
  SELECT 
    MIN(ST_Distance(h.geom::geometry, ec.geom::geometry)) AS distance_meters
  FROM 
    horseshoe_bend h,
    elevated_cells ec
)
SELECT 
  ROUND(distance_meters) AS distance_to_nearest_cell_meters
FROM 
  nearest_cell;
